name: Summer Music Clinic: Senior Session
what_you_do: A week on campus. You play in band, choir, orchestra and jazz groups. You take instrument and voice classes, composing and music tech. You also hear guest concerts.
who_can_apply: Students who are finishing grades 9 to 12. At sign-up, everyone picks a placement audition or a talk with staff.
pay_detail: Residential $1,275; daily commuter $875; Violin Institute $1,500; plus a $75 nonrefundable registration fee. Financial aid is available.
deadline_text: 2026 registration ran Jan 12 to May 15, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted.
notes: The Violin Institute has room for only 12 students. It needs a recorded audition. The date was April 1 in 2026.
